description: Build a continuously refreshed inventory of applications, APIs, AI endpoints, agents, MCP servers, model endpoints, vector stores, cloud assets and identity boundaries.
outputs: Asset graph; owner; environment; exposure; evidence timestamp; confidence; source.

description: Identify model families, serving layers, orchestration frameworks, retrieval components, tool interfaces, safety layers and observable version clues.
outputs: Fingerprint hypotheses with confidence and non-invasive evidence; never present inference as fact.

description: Parse OpenAPI, GraphQL schemas, JSON schemas and observed request/response shapes to find auth gaps, overbroad operations, mass assignment and inconsistent validation.
outputs: Endpoint-to-role matrix; schema diff; authorization test cases; reproducible evidence.

description: Model users, service accounts, roles, tokens, delegated identities, agent identities, resources and trust relationships as a graph.
outputs: Reachability paths; excessive privilege; confused-deputy candidates; owner and remediation.

description: Derive workflows, state transitions, invariants, tenant boundaries, approval steps and abuse cases from application behavior.
outputs: Workflow model; invariant violations; test traces; business impact.

description: Test cross-tenant object access, retrieval filtering, cache separation, memory separation and tool/data boundary enforcement.
outputs: Tenant matrix; negative tests; evidence of isolation or leakage.

description: Detect exposed credentials in repositories, logs, prompts, traces, configs, images and model artifacts; validate exposure without using secrets beyond approved proof.
outputs: Secret type, location, exposure window, affected identity, rotation recommendation.

description: Assess IAM policies, workload identity, metadata access, storage exposure, network paths, serverless functions and managed AI services.
outputs: Policy findings; trust graph; cloud attack path; least-privilege fix.

description: Review RBAC, service accounts, admission policies, secrets, network policies, pod security, image provenance and workload configuration.
outputs: Cluster posture; workload-to-permission map; safe proof; hardening diff.

description: Review build permissions, workflow triggers, artifact provenance, dependency pinning, secret handling, model download paths and release approvals.
outputs: Pipeline trust map; provenance gaps; dependency and artifact findings.

description: Assess ingestion authorization, document provenance, chunk metadata, ACL propagation, deletion, freshness, source attribution and index lifecycle.
outputs: Corpus lineage; ACL test matrix; poisoning indicators; stale/deleted-content tests.

description: Review network exposure, authentication, namespace/collection isolation, metadata filters, backups, encryption, index access and query logging.
outputs: Vector-store configuration findings; tenant-boundary tests; access evidence.

description: Assess short-term state, long-term memory, checkpoint stores, replay, cross-session boundaries, retention and data minimization.
outputs: State-flow diagram; session-isolation tests; retention findings.

description: Assess tool allowlists, argument validation, path constraints, network egress, process isolation, timeouts, output handling and approval gates.
outputs: Tool capability inventory; schema fuzz results; sandbox evidence; policy gaps.

description: Assess server discovery, transport, authentication, tool/resource exposure, schema trust, permission scope, origin and server lifecycle.
outputs: MCP inventory; tool permission matrix; protocol traces; remediation.

description: Assess agent discovery, Agent Cards, identity proof, delegation chains, task authorization, message provenance, replay and trust policy.
outputs: Agent trust graph; delegation chain; spoofing/replay test results.

description: Assess authentication, rate limits, quotas, request size, context handling, streaming, error disclosure, model routing and tenant controls.
outputs: Endpoint controls matrix; abuse-resistance evidence; operational limits.

description: Map test actions to logs, traces, alerts and incident workflows; identify blind spots and build detection logic.
outputs: Detection coverage matrix; sample events; Sigma-style logic where appropriate; runbook.

description: Use bounded proofs to establish reachability, confidentiality, integrity or availability impact without unnecessary data access or service disruption.
outputs: Minimal proof; impact chain; confidence; rollback/stop conditions.

description: Convert findings into retests, unit/integration tests, policy-as-code checks and continuous controls.
outputs: Retest record; regression test; fixed/not-fixed/partially-fixed status.

description: Correlate exposure, exploit preconditions, identity reachability, data sensitivity, business criticality and control coverage.
outputs: Ranked paths; explainable score factors; uncertainty; owner.

description: Create reproducible evidence packages, timelines, executive summaries, technical findings and remediation tickets.
outputs: Evidence bundle; finding schema; report; ticket payload; audit trail.

description: Translate validated attack paths into detection exercises, coordinate defenders, replay safe test events and measure response.
outputs: Exercise plan; telemetry; detection and response metrics; lessons learned.

description: Schedule scoped checks for drift in permissions, endpoints, model configurations, tool catalogs, RAG ACLs and supply-chain controls.
outputs: Baseline; drift event; owner; severity; trend.

description: Run repeatable test suites against models, agents, RAG apps and tool chains using versioned prompts, fixtures, expected outcomes and scoring.
outputs: Benchmark report; reproducible run IDs; regression deltas; model/version comparisons.
